newsitem.title: USA: Diebold 1996 terminal shipments hit record.
newsitem.headline: Diebold 1996 terminal shipments hit record.

text.p: Diebold Inc said on Tuesday it shipped a record 26,043 InterBold self-service terminals worldwide in 1996, up 27 percent from the year before.
The shipments include automatic teller machines and cash dispensers. Diebold said it also shipped 12,100 upgrade modules.
"Our largest gains came in Latin America, where a stronger economy and the increased mini-branch activity helped boost shipments by 78 percent, to 2,927 units," a Diebold spokesman said.
Shipments in Asia were up 43 percent, the company added.
